item.text: `strings.Fields` collapses the empty release column before parsing. I also found that source RPM parsing splits from the right without checking whether the remaining name and version are valid. I’ll use a shared version builder so the installed and repoquery paths handle empty releases the same way.

The parser changes are in place. I’ve also updated the existing case for the `-src.rpm` filename form. Next I’ll add focused tests for empty release columns, both source filename forms, and malformed filenames, then run the scanner tests.

item.text:
Fixed RPM parsing in [redhatbase.go](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go). Empty release fields now stay in position for `rpm -qa` and repoquery output, including tab-delimited lines. Source RPM filename parsing accepts the requested `-src.rpm` forms and rejects malformed filenames. Update candidates use the shared epoch formatting logic.
